desc: Derive the exact effect of one operation on the gap sequence (swap g_i and g_{i+2}, leave g_{i+1} fixed) and confirm parity classes are preserved.
Establish reachability: swaps of gaps two apart generate all permutations within each index-parity class; total = N*X_1 + sum_j (N-j)*g_j with X_1 invariant.
Implement the solver: group gaps by index parity, sort each group ascending, place ascending gaps into ascending position indices per parity class, compute N*X_1 + sum (N-j)*g_j, print to stdout.
Validate on given samples (expect 21 and 41) -- both passed; logic verified by hand for both samples.
Confirm performance/edge cases: O(N log N), Python big ints handle 2e5 * 1e12 range.
